findings: Viewed all 18 painted masters and all 72 native crops/icons on the dated contact sheets.
Faces/species, hair/helm and equipment remain distinct; upper-left material light and warm/cool contrast match the selected painted Demacia style.
Large and small portraits use independently composed crops and uniform resampling; specialty art uses a separately generated master.
Native UI backgrounds remain painted and varied rather than empty dark gradients.
Decorative generated background pennant shapes are not verified canonical Noxian crest evidence.
